label: Phones paired with this Daylight send here. To add another, show the code.

Instant delivery
Keeps a connection open so items arrive within seconds (a small notification stays). Off: every 15 minutes, and whenever this screen is open.
Android lets the Inbox open the Reader only while you’re looking at it, unless you allow “Display over other apps”; without it, new items wait for a tap on a notification.
When a PDF or another document arrives while you use another app:

Ask with a notification
A card over the Reader (with “Display over other apps”) and a notification show its name. Tap Add to Reader to add it; the Reader opens it. Later keeps it here.

Add to the library as a batch
Hands documents over together, for a Reader that adds a batch to its library without opening it. Today’s Daylight Reader doesn’t yet: it opens a single document, and for two or more it shows its library, which closes the document you’re reading.

Open as they arrive
The Reader imports each document and opens it, even while you read something else.
Notifications are off, so items that wait for a tap stay here unseen until you open the Inbox.
